en.headline: Employers in your area who are struggling to hire
en.subheadline: Each week we flag local companies with roles open for 30+ days or several vacancies at once – with the role, the date we first saw it and the source.

signals.title: Roles open 30+ days
signals.text: A vacancy that stays open for a month is often the moment a hiring manager is open to agency support.

signals.title: Several roles at once
signals.text: Companies hiring for three or more roles at the same time usually need help with volume.

signals.title: Source for every lead
signals.text: Each lead links to the employer's own careers page, so your consultants can call with a specific reason.

faq.q: Where does the data come from?
faq.a: From official company registers, official announcements and companies' own careers pages. We do not use LinkedIn, job boards or other platforms whose terms forbid it.
No. Each lead contains company data only: name, address, website, main phone number where published, the event and its source.

faq.q: How often do I receive leads?
faq.a: Every Monday as a spreadsheet, filtered to your areas and signals. Each lead is delivered to you only once.

faq.q: What does the free sample include?
faq.a: 10 current leads from your area, with the same fields as the regular delivery. No obligation.
